compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: skelet.agent.v1 envelope unchanged, existing tools/routes untouched except additive find_similar schema/branch/route, tool inventory counts 16->17 updated in three tests, skills validator promotion upcoming->implemented, CI assets job gains one suite file? correctness.instructions: Is the similarity correct and deterministic: token-set Jaccard over title/summary/canonical_text/tags, 4-decimal rounding, self excluded, zero scores excluded, order score-desc/title/id-asc, candidate cap default 500 with explicit truncation flag, limit 1..50 default 20, offset cursor opaque? Do the committed tests prove ordering (0.6/0.1667/0.1429 fixtures), tie-break, kinds/limit/offset, truncation, and MCP/REST deep-equal parity?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 9 similarity DB tests plus 3 transport parity tests pass locally, assets 22/22 and web/node/worker 110/110 green, lint/typecheck clean on both workspaces, python 170 plus all validators plus no-model gate pass, graft build/check green, CI will re-verify at exact head? Any passing-test-only claim without integration coverage?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: is sort fully deterministic (no locale-dependent collation, no timestamp ordering), is the candidate cap enforced in SQL with stable id order, are timeouts/cancellation needed for an in-memory scored query, does reference-text extraction handle null summary/canonical_text and non-object metadata without throwing?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond bounded find_similar: embeddings, pgvector, semantic claims, compare_design, get_changes, MCP Apps, corpus importers, OpenPencil, billing, UI redesign, or unrelated refactors? Is compare_design explicitly deferred?

security.instructions: Do the R2 guarantees hold: reference readable-check via getArtifactForActor with no oracle (malformed/unknown/denied all FORBIDDEN_OR_NOT_FOUND on both transports, proven by the no-oracle test), candidates filtered by the workspace-membership predicate before scoring, readable-but-restricted reference answers RIGHTS_RESTRICTED, candidates carry rights labels with metadata-only serving and no bytes, requestId/cursor sanitized, error bodies static with leak-check assertions, no shell/subprocess/network?
